content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ESIC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Full Time Specialist: PG Degree or equivalent with 03-year Post PG experience or PG Diploma with 05-year post PG experience in respective specialty from recognized university with valid MCI/State Medical Council registration. Senior Resident: PG Degree or diploma / DNB in concerned specialty from recognized university with valid MCI/State Medical Council registration. Senior/Junior Resident (GDMO): PG Degree or diploma / DNB preferred; otherwise MBBS with experience/good clinical knowledge with valid MCI/State Medical Council registration.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 69 years Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS as per rules.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Specialist: Rs. 121408 Per Month Senior Resident: Rs. 121048 - 121408 Per Month Senior/Junior Resident (GDMO): Rs. 121048 Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC?
faq.answer: ESIC has announced a total of 16 vacancies for the posts of Specialist / Senior Resident / Senior/Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 69 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, including PG Degree/Diploma with experience, or MBBS with experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 121048 to Rs. 121408 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ESIC, Bikaner, Rajasthan, 334001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.
